stage1.impression: A warm, believable night view through a shopfront into a long timber bar, with good fluted oak, true verticals and a sensible exposure (frame median 36.9). It still reads as CG: the faceless, ghosted mannequin figures, an even haze veil, a flat beige fascia where the room's focal point should glow, and a foreground window plinth that is the brightest thing in the frame. As it stands it is a competent but generic bar, not yet a specific place a magazine would publish, because the lantern at the end does not read as a lit object.

blocking_9: The lantern's acrylic band must read at a glance as glowing amber fins and be the brightest architectural element in the frame, brighter than the window plinth
People must read as real patrons (clothing, hands, posture) or be absent; no ghosted, faceless mannequins
The shopfront glass must be legible as glass: a faint, clean street reflection in the dark upper area
Haze must not flatten the deep shadows; the far plaster wall and ceiling need real blacks with detail
The eye's path must run plinth -> counter -> lantern, with light rising toward the back of the room rather than falling off
Saturated colour limited to the products: the band reads amber, not beige, and the grade does not tint every neutral orange

defects.what: The lantern's acrylic band reads as a flat pale beige fascia (lum_median 132, b_median 96), not as lit amber fins; no edge glow, no fin rhythm except a faint stripe at its right end
Window plinth is the brightest region in the frame (lum_median 94, p95 173), pulling the eye to the foreground and away from the lantern
Ghosted, double-exposed standing figure behind the counter; motion blur reads as a render artefact, not a person moving
Seated figures are smooth faceless mannequins with no clothing detail; they read as game NPCs
Haze veils the right-hand plaster wall into a grey fog (p5 19.4); scalloped spot patterns look like a soft CG gradient, not plaster
Large flat dark panel on the right wastes about a sixth of the frame and carries no material detail
Upper third is an empty dark ceiling with no reflection on the shop glass; nothing tells the viewer they are outside looking through glass
Front face of the shop table/counter is crushed to near black (lum_median 13.5) with no steel or oak detail
Shelf of Core lamps in eight tints plus purple and coral pendants make the frame multicoloured; the glowing shelf LED lines are thin, hard and look like tape lights

changes.problem: The lantern, the reason for the frame, does not glow: its band reads as a beige fascia lit from outside.

evidence.measured: lum_median 132.5, r/g/b 174/124/96; lower than the window plinth's p95 173 and no edge highlight on the fins

change.to: 1.2 (and warm the source to about 2200 K so the Smoke fins transmit amber)

changes.expected: The band becomes the brightest architectural element, a saturated amber strip with visible fin edges, lum_median about 185, blue channel well below red.

changes.problem: The foreground window plinth outshines the whole room and steals the eye.

evidence.measured: lum_median 94.1, p95 173.0; brighter than the lantern face (72.6)

change.setting: the street spill on the window plinth (the street) and the Cores' emission on the plinth
change.to: halve the street light reaching the plinth; drop the plinth Cores' emission by about 40 %

changes.expected: Plinth sits as a warm, readable foreground ledge, darker than the lantern so the eye travels back.

changes.problem: The figures read as faceless mannequins, and the blurred standing one ghosts into a double image.

evidence.measured: seen at 2x: smooth untextured bodies, no hands or clothing folds; standing figure semi-transparent

change.to: 2 seated figures with dressed, textured clothing, backs or three-quarter backs to camera, shutter 0.25; remove the standing ghost

changes.expected: Signs of life without CG tells; a coat over a stool and a glass or two can carry the rest.

changes.problem: Haze lifts all shadows into a grey veil, flattening the plaster and the far room.

evidence.measured: lum_p5 19.4, lum_range 81; wall reads as fog with soft scallops

changes.expected: Deeper, cleaner shadows on the plaster wall with the spot scallops crisper; light pools separate from dark.

changes.problem: The light falls off toward the back instead of rising to the lantern; the baffle face is no brighter than the counter zone.

change.setting: the baffle's graze; the counter spots
change.to: graze 1.4 W/m2 at 2400 K; counter 4 x 26 W

changes.expected: The slotted oak face glows with raking light and reads as a freestanding lit box at the end of the room.

changes.problem: The shop glass is invisible, so the frame does not read as seen from the sidewalk.

evidence.measured: lum_median 17.8, no reflected shapes in the dark upper area despite glass reflection 0.6

change.to: add a dim sodium/LED streetlight and a lit facade opposite so the glass picks up a faint, undistorted reflection in the upper left third; keep reflection 0.6

changes.expected: A ghost of the street in the top of the glass, low contrast, giving the passer-by viewpoint.

changes.problem: The dark right-hand panel and empty ceiling take about a third of the frame while the lantern sits small at centre-left.

evidence.measured: lum_median 21.6, no detail; lantern occupies about 12 % of the frame

change.to: shift about 0.6 m to +y and use 40 mm, aimed at the lantern's centre, keeping verticals true

changes.expected: The lantern grows to about a sixth of the frame and the dead panel shrinks to a thin dark edge framing the view.

changes.problem: The shop table's front face is crushed with no steel or oak detail.

change.to: 1 x 8.0 W, 30 deg, aimed to spill a little onto the front edge

changes.expected: Table front legible as blackened steel/oak with a soft sheen, still low key.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the number of tinted Cores and coloured pendants so the frame has one saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes EARF's products as placed (Cores and Hemispheres in tints); only their light levels may change

out_of_scope.request: Make the acrylic fins thicker or show more of them
out_of_scope.why: The acrylic band's place and fins are fixed by the card
